```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Load Seurat object

```{r load}
obj <- readRDS("/mnt/data/tosuke/R/scRNAseq_Pn/github/Pna_UMAP.rds")
ncol(obj) # No. of cells
nrow(obj) # No. of genes
```

## Set cell-type identities

```{r idents, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
Idents(obj) <- "cell_type"

levels(obj) <- c(
  "Digestive",
  "Endoderm-like I",
  "Endoderm-like II and III",
  "Endodermal progenitor",
  "Stem cells",
  "Cilia related",
  "Epithelial",
  "Muscle",
  "Neurons",
  "Sensory neurons",
  "TRP+ neurons",
  "Secretory cells",
  "Unknown"
)

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1) + NoLegend()
```

## Find marker genes for each cell type

```{r find-markers}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE)

write.csv(markers,
          "/mnt/data/tosuke/R/scRNAseq_Pn/github/Pna_markers_celltype.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

head(markers)
```

## Select top 10 marker genes per cell type

```{r markers}
top10 <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct.1)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = levels(obj))) %>%
  arrange(cluster)  

table(top10$cluster)

obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = top10$gene)
```

## DoHeatmap

```{r doheatmap, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10}
DoHeatmap(obj, features = top10$gene, group.by = "ident") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("white","white","#F0F921FF", "#FCA636FF", "#E16462FF","#B12A90FF","#6A00A8FF","#0D0887FF"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.5, 0.8, 1.5, 3, 4, 4.2, 5)),
    limits = c(0, 3),
    oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "white",
    name = "Expression"
  )
```

## Matrix of values underlying DoHeatmap

```{r doheatmap-matrix}
p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(obj, features = top10$gene, group.by = "ident")
heatmap_df <- p_heatmap$data  # Feature, Cell, Expression, Identity

# Drop the blank spacer columns DoHeatmap inserts between groups
heatmap_df <- heatmap_df %>% dplyr::filter(Cell %in% colnames(obj))

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Feature, Cell, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, Cell, Expression) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Cell, values_from = Expression) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Feature")

# Row order: cluster order from top10, genes de-duplicated (first occurrence)
gene_order <- unique(top10$gene)
gene_order <- gene_order[gene_order %in% rownames(heatmap_matrix)]
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[gene_order, ]

# Column order: same cell order (grouped/sorted by identity) as the heatmap
cell_order <- heatmap_df %>% dplyr::distinct(Cell, Identity) %>% dplyr::arrange(Identity)
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, cell_order$Cell]

dim(heatmap_matrix)  # genes x cells

# Cell type (Identity) per barcode, in the same column order as the matrix
cell_annotation <- cell_order
colnames(cell_annotation) <- c("Cell", "CellType")
```
